name: Hamidashi Creative Totsu
original_name: ハミダシクリエイティブ凸
source:
A fandisc that includes after stories for the four main heroines and a new route for sub-heroine Ameri.

[url=/c91566]Ameri[/url]: Entering summer holiday, Tomohiro remembers a promise he made with Ameri. Thinking back on it, he planned a castle tour plan with the student council, but on the tour, things began to roll in an unexpected direction.

[url=/c87837]Hiyori[/url]: It's been a year since Tomohiro dated his little sister, it's a new life that's filled with affection and... jealousy?

[url=/c87838]Kano[/url]: Finally the two of them begin to rent their love nest. There's a lot in this new life that could not be shown to kids.

[url=/c87839]Asumi[/url]: While Asumi is unexpectedly assertive in their harmonious love life, she is preparing to jump into a big live stage...!

[url=/c87840]Shio[/url]: Big shock as the former all-in-one former student council president repeats a year. She's plotting a revenge in the next school festival...!?

[Translated from the [url=https://madosoft.net/totsu/story]official website[/url]]
translation:
一张同人光盘，包括四位主要女主角的后续故事和副女主角阿梅里的新路线。

[url=/c91566]Ameri[/url]：进入暑假，Tomohiro想起了他与Ameri的承诺。回想起来，他和学生会一起策划了一次城堡参观计划，但在参观过程中，事情开始朝着意想不到的方向发展。

[url=/c87837]日和[/url]：智博和妹妹约会已经一年了，这是一个充满感情和……嫉妒的新生活？

[url=/c87838]Kano[/url]：终于他们两个开始租他们的爱巢了。新生活中有很多东西无法向孩子们展示。

[url=/c87839]Asumi[/url]：虽然Asumi在他们和谐的爱情生活中出人意料地自信，但她正准备跳入大型现场舞台……！

[url=/c87840]Shio[/url]：前学生会主席重读一年，令人震惊。她正计划在下一个学园祭进行复仇……！？

[翻译自[url=https://madosoft.net/totsu/story]官网[/url]]
